mapper.select: SELECT * FROM screening_seat WHERE record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY seat_code
mapper.update: UPDATE screening_seat SET status = 1, lock_order_no = #{orderNo}, lock_expire_at = NOW() + INTERVAL #{expireMinutes} MINUTE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND seat_code = #{seatCode} AND status = 0

UPDATE screening_seat SET status = 1, lock_order_no = #{orderNo}, lock_expire_at = NOW() + INTERVAL #{expireMinutes} MINUTE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND status = 0 AND seat_code IN
#{code}

UPDATE screening_seat ss JOIN ordered o ON o.record_id = ss.record_id SET ss.status = 0, ss.lock_order_no = NULL, ss.lock_expire_at = NULL, ss.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ss.status = 1 AND ss.lock_order_no = #{orderNo}

UPDATE screening_seat ss JOIN ordered o ON o.orders = #{orderNo} AND o.record_id = ss.record_id SET ss.status = 0, ss.lock_order_no = NULL, ss.lock_expire_at = NULL, ss.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ss.status = 2 AND FIND_IN_SET(ss.seat_code, REPLACE(o.seat, '，', ','))

UPDATE screening_seat ss JOIN ordered o ON o.record_id = ss.record_id SET ss.status = 2, ss.lock_order_no = NULL, ss.lock_expire_at = NULL, ss.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ss.status = 1 AND ss.lock_order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO screening_seat (record_id, seat_code, status) VALUES
(#{recordId}, #{code}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screening_seat WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND status IN (1, 2)
mapper.update: UPDATE screening_seat SET status = 0, lock_order_no = NULL, lock_expire_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 1 AND lock_expire_at IS NOT NULL AND lock_expire_at <= NOW()
